scope: Isolated operational Inventory SQLite fixture and Suite/FAM/SRM automated regressions. No live company data used for test writes.
status_definition: Pass applies only to the explicitly recorded execution scope, not certification of all 50 full browser workflows. Blocked includes unavailable/unestablished capabilities and incomplete execution.
fixes: Skip inventory issue for non-stock services, prevent service restocking on cancellation, omit service lines from picklists, and reject service-only fulfillment documents.
Compute missing due dates from effective invoice date plus customer calendar-day terms; retain explicit overrides; remove misleading prefilled due dates.
Reject nonpositive/invalid transfer quantities and invalid statuses/warehouse IDs before creating stock records; normalize same-warehouse comparisons.
Bind an open POS drawer to its opening cashier even if a stale cookie references another drawer.
Show persisted change on the POS receipt.
limitations: All 50 complete browser workflows were not executed. Browser control later repeatedly timed out and reset while Chrome was active.

The screenshot captures the initial paid service invoice QA-BROWSER-101 before service fulfillment actions were hidden. The final QA-BROWSER-101-FINAL invoice, zero balance, correct due date and absent delivery/picklist actions were independently observed in Chrome accessibility state and saved fixture records.
Browser fixture was restarted between those two service executions; IDs are local to each disposable execution.
SQLite checks do not certify PostgreSQL concurrency, migrations, external gateway behavior, or unconfigured accounting policies.
The Suite React application and operational Inventory Flask application are distinct surfaces; a pass in one is not a pass in the other.

workflows.execution_scope: Browser and automated service invoice segment; complete order approval/confirmation chain not executed.
workflows.expected: Revenue is ₹5,000, tax ₹900, and outstanding zero; no stock reservation, delivery requirement, or inventory movement is incorrectly created.
workflows.actual: QA-BROWSER-101-FINAL: subtotal 5000, tax 900, total/paid 5900, balance 0. Service stock remains 0, physical stock 10, no inventory movements. Service fulfillment controls hidden and direct delivery/picklist actions blocked.
